speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are experiencing difficulties conceiving and discomfort during sexual activity; to better assist you, could you please describe the specific nature and location of the pain you feel?

speaker: Patient
text: 30-year-old female. The patient and her husband have been trying to conceive for 15 months without success. They are sexually active at least twice a week. The husband occasionally has difficulties maintaining an erection. The patient reports discomfort and pelvic floor muscle tension during attempted vaginal penetration. Diagnosed with body dysmorphic disorder three years ago. No family history of serious illness. She is a non-smoker and does not drink alcohol. No medications.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Vaginismus (likely secondary to body dysmorphic disorder).

Given the 15-month infertility attempt and the specific description of pelvic floor muscle tension causing pain on penetration, is the pain located at the vaginal opening or deeper in the pelvis?
